load_data: load an ImageFolder or YFCC100M dataset from a given data path argument
get_data_transformations: get clustering and training image transformations with optional rotation augmentation
rotate_img: rotate a numpy image array by 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees
KFoldSampler: create a PyTorch sampler that iterates over image indices grouped by target class
per_target: group a list of image-target tuples into a dictionary keyed by target label
